title: Add error_code and error properties to device classes
body:
## Summary
- Maps device error codes to human-readable strings via enums
- Provides a uniform `error_code` (int) / `error` (str) interface across all Gen1 device classes
- Updates examples to display errors

## Test plan
- [ ] Verify `error` returns `None` when no error is present (code 0)
- [ ] Verify `error` returns the enum name string for known error codes
- [ ] Verify `error` falls back to the raw int string for unknown codes
